sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment 
inspection checklist I2, which must be performed every six months as indicated 
by M6 in the title block .

Turbine bearing is the bearing which carry the weight of all running parts of 
the unit and carry the vertical water force component

Thrust bearing is located up to the main bearing and 
it is carried by the turbine cover

This document shows the protective maintenance to discover any oil leakage and 
check the pumps and filterate the oil.

This document is initiated and tested by eng. Ahmed Abd El Kader Mahmoud, 
accepted by eng. Atty Seiffen general manager, and approved by eng. Mohamed 
Abd El Baset Head Sector of Aswan Dam 1&2 PS and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.
The unit must be stopped and the break on
The oil circulating pumps must be off
Gate lock and break must be on
